claim.excerpt: Furthermore, a partial overlap was found with the blood values relating to cases of death due to natural causes, in which the finding of fentanyl was considered accidental (n = 12, range: 2.7–33 ng/mL, mean 12 ng/mL).

sources.title: Atypical Fentanyl Transdermal Patch Consumption and Fatalities: Case Report and Literature Review

why_it_matters: Concentration values are often misread as thresholds; the reviewer must confirm specimen, population, statistic and that the value is reported in context only.

conflicts.question: Can a fentanyl blood concentration alone separate fentanyl-attributed deaths from incidental findings?
conflicts.note: The source reports partial overlap with blood values in natural-cause deaths where fentanyl was considered incidental (n = 12, 2.7–33 ng/mL).
